# LearnSQL.com

> > LearnSQL.com is an interactive online platform offering comprehensive SQL courses, certifications, and practice exercises for learners at all levels.

LearnSQL.com provides structured learning paths from SQL fundamentals through advanced techniques like window functions and CTEs, with specialized tracks for data analysis, marketing, and healthcare professionals. The platform emphasizes hands-on practice with real-world datasets and offers skill assessments for career advancement.

## Key Topics

- SQL Fundamentals
- JOINs (LEFT, RIGHT, FULL)
- Window Functions
- Common Table Expressions (CTEs)
- GROUP BY & Aggregation
- CASE WHEN Statements
- Subqueries
- Data Analysis
- PostgreSQL
- MySQL
- Interactive Exercises
- SQL Certification
- Query Optimization
- Database Queries
- Online Learning

## Core Learning Paths

- [SQL From A To Z](https://learnsql.com/track/sql-from-a-to-z): Comprehensive SQL fundamentals track covering essentials for beginners.
- [SQL Practice](https://learnsql.com/track/sql-practice): Interactive SQL practice track for JOINs, aggregation, and subqueries.
- [Advanced SQL](https://learnsql.com/track/advanced-sql): Advanced SQL track covering window functions and recursive queries.
- [SQL for Data Analysis](https://learnsql.com/track/sql-for-data-analysis): SQL learning track tailored for data analysis fundamentals.

## SQL Courses & Skill Building

- [SQL Courses](https://learnsql.com/sql-courses): Main SQL course catalog with beginner to advanced learning paths.
- [SQL Basics](https://learnsql.com/course/sql-queries): Beginner SQL course covering basic queries and operators.
- [SQL JOINs](https://learnsql.com/course/joins): Interactive SQL JOINs course teaching LEFT, RIGHT, FULL joins.
- [Window Functions](https://learnsql.com/course/window-functions): Master SQL window functions for rankings and running totals.
- [Recursive Queries & CTEs](https://learnsql.com/course/common-table-expressions): Interactive course on SQL CTEs and recursive query optimization.
- [SQL Skills Assessment](https://learnsql.com/sql-skill-assessment): SQL skill assessment tool with certification for career advancement.

## Specialized Learning Tracks

- [SQL Reporting](https://learnsql.com/track/sql-reporting): SQL reporting track for creating complex multilevel data reports.
- [SQL for Marketing](https://learnsql.com/track/sql-for-marketing): SQL track for marketing professionals analyzing customer data.
- [SQL for Healthcare](https://learnsql.com/track/sql-for-healthcare): SQL track for healthcare professionals and data analysts.

## Practice & Projects

- [Basic SQL Practice: Blog & Traffic Data](https://learnsql.com/course/basic-sql-practice-blog): 141 interactive SQL practice exercises for beginners with real data.
- [Revenue Trend Analysis in SQL](https://learnsql.com/course/sql-revenue-trend-analysis): SQL course for trend analysis and revenue report building.
